attacks.finding: Post-merge bootstrap completion is not independently verifiable. The seed requires a maintainer to record local terminal completion and synchronized closure, but does not require a SHA-bound artifact containing the integration revision, candidate digest, exact changed-path validation result, and post-merge issue-sync check result. A maintainer could assert completion without leaving deterministic evidence linking those facts.
attacks.resolution: Add a maintainer closeout record/schema requiring the integration SHA, frozen Candidate digest, exact-path predicate result, all six projection digests/statuses, and successful post-merge issue-sync verification.

attacks.finding: Candidate invalidation is specified for semantic role reports but not explicitly for append-only dispositions, readiness state, or any bootstrap closeout artifact derived from the Candidate. A changed planning contract could leave apparently valid bookkeeping that no longer corresponds to the frozen Candidate.
attacks.resolution: State that any Candidate, contract, prompt, schema, policy, or planning change invalidates all derived role dispositions, readiness/closeout artifacts, and their dependent projection claims; require regeneration against the new Candidate.

missingSpecCases: Maintainer merge followed by verification that the merged tree contains exactly the frozen six-contract payload and no evidence outside the seed evidence directory.
Post-merge projection drift or unexpected GitHub closure detected and recorded as a blocking condition.
Tampered, stale, or missing bootstrap maintainer-closeout artifact.
residualRisks: The explicit one-time maintainer-reviewed bootstrap appropriately handles base-revision self-authorization; no custom PKI is required.
Future role replay, self-review, host attestation, and dependency-graph enforcement are delegated to the existing role-evidence contracts and future implementation slices.
Several packets have broad overlapping allowed paths, but all declare Parallel-safe: no; the contract-domain ownership remains distinct.
